issues.description: The problem statement specifies that Book.title is a String, but in the solution Book.title is declared as an Int. This type mismatch also conflicts with the solution's Client implementation which constructs Book instances using String literals for titles. This will confuse students and causes the provided solution code to be internally inconsistent and uncompilable.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Book.title property in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift from Int to String so it matches the problem statement and the way Book instances are constructed in Client. Ensure the Book initializer and all usages expect a String title.
